_comment: foods.json — the curated food registry for auto nutrition (Phase 29a).
One entry per food, ordered by slug. Authored fields: slug, display_name,
fdc_id, aliases, is_added_sugar, grams_per_ml, portions, note. The
`extracted` object is WRITTEN BY tool/fdc.dart from the USDA FoodData
Central CSV bundle — never edit it by hand; re-run `melos run fdc:extract`
instead. Authored `grams_per_ml` and `portions` win over extracted values
of the same unit. `fdc_id` names the data source, not an identity claim —
a proxy mapping (rice vinegar -> cider vinegar's row) is allowed when the
nutrition is equivalent and the `note` says so. Aliases are lowercase and
globally unique; they should cover the corpus spelling of every ingredient
the food is meant to link (see README.md for the workflow).

foods.note: 00 pizza flour mapped here — nutritionally equivalent to all-purpose; FDC has no 00 row.
A market bunch of asparagus is about a pound; authored because FDC has only per-spear portions.

portions.from: avocado, NS as to Florida or California

foods.note: Bunch weight authored — a retail basil bunch runs 2–2.5 oz.
The registry's neutral-oil default; a bare 'oil' links here.
Foundation grape-tomato row (SR has none). Dry-pint clamshell authored at ~10.5 oz.
Bunch weight authored — a retail cilantro bunch is ~3 oz.
Proxy: FDC's only generic prepared mustard is yellow; dijon is nutritionally equivalent at label precision.
One egg is a LARGE egg (50 g) by baking convention — FDC's medium row would win the parser's fallback otherwise.
FDC's whole-eggplant portion (~1.25 lb), authored because the modifier does not parse to a size word.
Bunch weight authored — a retail parsley bunch is ~2 oz.
FDC's per-pepper portion, authored because the modifier ('pepper') defeats the parser.
FDC's per-leek portion, authored because the modifier ('leek') needs the display-name rule.
Same FDC row as red bell pepper; separate entry so a bare count means one ~30 g mini, not a 119 g bell.
One row serves every raw-onion colour — the label difference is below display precision.
FDC's per-crust portion, authored because the modifier ('pie crust') needs the display-name rule.
The corpus's bare 'pork' (skewers) is closest to lean loin; shoulder cuts would need their own row.
Proxy: FDC has no generic prosciutto; sliced deli ham (~11% fat) is the nearest row. Retail package authored at 3 oz.
Proxy: FDC has no generic rice vinegar; cider vinegar's row is nutritionally equivalent at label precision.
FDC's 80-proof distilled-spirits row; one row serves every plain spirit.
Retail pouch authored at 3 oz drained weight.
Zeros across the label — mapped so watery rows count as counted instead of padding the not-counted list.
